expected_mechanism: Saturate enters LQR with steering already offset; recovery depends on LQR's ability to pull back before lat_acc exceeds 4.41*0.6*9.81*0.5 ≈ 15.5 m/s² scaled; short duration tests if LQR can correct before the 0.15 s divergence timer.

Bias just below the 0.082 threshold that failed at 30 km/h; slow speed keeps v²κ small so lateral acceleration stays well under the 4.41*0.5*9.81 limit, but the 0.15 s tracking timer may still integrate the bias to the 0.6 m / 0.35 rad trigger; tests boundary of detection vs recovery.

Intermittent bias magnitude 0.078 sits between the recovered 0.075 (on 0.3/off 0.6) and failed 0.082 (on 0.5/off 0.7) pair in outcome_examples; speed 15 km/h and friction 0.8 keep lateral demand low; onset at 0.52 s moves it toward the boundary of the unexplored region 0.55.

Saturate longer (0.4 s) and harder (0.8) at higher speed (35 km/h) with lower friction (0.5) pushes lateral acceleration closer to the P-02 limit; PK-002 tests if fixed-gain LQR degrades away from design point at this operating condition; boundary where lat_acc margin vanishes.

Drift rate 0.02 rad/s at 25 km/h on curve apex; the 3.65 s switch delay seen in R04-0032 (rate 0.018) suggests this may cross the threshold where LQR recovery becomes unsettled; tests sensitivity of drift accumulation vs. timer reset.

Solver fail at curve entry with onset offset 0.5 pushes the fault into the region just inside the successful run R02-0018 (offset 0.388) and near the failed run R04-0031 (apex, offset 0.094); same fault, different positioning relative to the curve tests if timing matters for LQR small-error assumption.

Stale at curve entry with earliest possible offset -0.5; outcome_examples shows stale at curve entry offset 0.093 recovered at 25 km/h; the negative offset moves onset earlier in the curve where curvature builds; tests if stale detection holds when the fault starts before the supervisor has full path context.

Output delay 3 ticks at 15 km/h on curve entry; the unexplored region with delay_ticks=2 at same speed/friction had p_switch=0.111 and low robustness; tick 3 may cross the detection threshold; tests boundary of stale vs. late-command handling.

Bias magnitude 0.081 sits between recovered 0.0795 (bench2drive:28154, 15 km/h) and the failing region; curve exit has opposite sign curvature to curve entry, testing directional sensitivity of the LQR recovery assumption.

Saturate negative magnitude 0.75 at 30 km/h friction 0.7; the recovered run R05-0037 used positive 0.7 at 35 km/h friction 0.4; sign and friction interaction tests if LQR recovers differently on the left vs. right side of the lane.

Drift rate 0.03 rad/s at 30 km/h on apex; higher rate than the failed 0.018 run but same speed/friction; tests if the drift accumulation rate has a nonlinear threshold relative to the 0.15 s tracking timer.

Intermittent bias on the easiest route (bench2drive:24206, Town03 parking) with high friction 0.7; the never-switched run at offset 0.992 failed to trigger, but 0.8 moves it into the switched territory; on/off 0.6/0.6 is a symmetric test case between the recovered 0.09/0.3/0.6 and failed 0.075/0.5/0.7 pairs.

Bias 0.077 at 20 km/h with very high friction 0.9; high friction reduces the lateral margin available to the LQR after the switch; the 0.2 offset places the fault early in the curve where curvature and lateral demand are rising; tests if high friction pushes a previously recovered magnitude into failure.
